summary: Walker Wayland Advantage is a Melbourne CBD firm (William Street, over 90 years) offering accounting and bookkeeping, audit, tax, business advisory and virtual CFO, and is part of the Walker Wayland Australasia and BKR networks. Martin Phelan is a long-standing partner. The firm's own 2023 virtual CFO article describes completing a client's monthly reconciliations and removing manual accounting functions, a strong new angle for a follow-up.

hooks.text: New angle: the firm's own virtual CFO article describes completing a client's monthly reconciliations and removing manual functions, which maps directly to Vert.
Martin's remit on valuations, cash flows and budgeting, plus the firm's recent LinkedIn posts on trusts and ATO benchmarks, show a business-advisory focus where clean books matter.

risks.text: Small team (about 14 on LinkedIn, down year on year) and a firm that emphasises ISO-certified, personal service; may favour proven manual process.
Martin Phelan is a senior partner focused on tax and corporate transactions rather than day-to-day bookkeeping; may forward to a virtual CFO lead.
The reconciliation article is from September 2023, so older than 18 months.

gaps: No recent posts or interviews by Martin personally found.
No Xero/MYOB/Dext tech stack mentions on the firm's own pages found.

followUp.body:

Vert does that reconciling and cash coding in minutes, with an audit trail on every match, so your virtual CFO team could take on more without more hours.
